name: sun
description: A clear circular sun with eight short, evenly spaced rays.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The circular disc preserves the real celestial silhouette and is an intentional exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. At the owner request, the disc radius increases from 4.25 to 5.1 and the eight radial centerlines shorten from 2 to 1 unit, running from radius 8.2 to 9.2. The disc remains centered at 12,12. Round caps and Regular 1.70 stroke are retained, giving equal visible margins of 1.95 units and a minimum disc-to-ray gap of 1.4 units. Overall dimensions are unchanged. Native proportions are the reference; static draft awaiting owner review.
